Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-Service operation with affiliates distributing ransomware; collecting and stealing sensitive data before encrypting systems; leaking stolen data in stages to incentivize ransom payment; threats to publish or sell stolen data if ransom not paid; using ransomware payments shared between affiliates and operators; emailing stock exchanges to pressure publicly traded companies
Indicators of Compromise: Download links to files with stolen financial and personal data
Archive of over 70,000 documents and 60,000 customer records
Leaked employee severance information, cash projections, money owed
Threats of publishing full data cache if ransom not paid
Data exchange platforms frequented by cybercriminals
